title: super_tools
description: This mod adds four super tools: Axe, Sword, Shovel, and Pickaxel.
body:
# ⚡ Emerald & Diamond Super Tools

Welcome to **Emerald & Diamond Super Tools**! This mod introduces a set of 4 ultra-powerful, end-game tools to upgrade your survival experience. 

If you are tired of the vanilla mining speed and want to dominate your Minecraft world, this mod is designed perfectly for you.

---

## 🔥 Key Features

Our mod adds 4 super-powered tools, each possessing distinct strengths and unmatched attributes:

*   🗡️ **Super Sword:** Inflicts massive, devastating attack damage to wipe out bosses and mobs instantly.
*   ⛏️ **Super Pickaxe:** Obliterates stone-related blocks with extreme mining speed.
*   🪓 **Super Axe:** Chops down trees and clears forests effortlessly.
*   💎 **Super Shovel:** Provides lightning-fast digging through dirt, sand, and gravel.

---

## 🛠️ Crafting & Maintenance

To balance their extreme powers, these tools require valuable materials to craft and maintain:

*   **Crafting Recipes:** Items can be crafted using a combination of **emeralds, gold, and diamonds** in the crafting table.
*   **Repairing Material:** Due to their legendary durability, you must use **Diamond Blocks** on an anvil to fully repair these tools.

---

## 📝 Configuration & Notes
*   **Modpacks:** Feel free to include this mod in any of your public or private modpacks!
*   **Feedback:** If you encounter any bugs or have feature suggestions, please leave a comment or open an issue.
